mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) over the prior month signals an accommodative monetary policy shift that reduces equity discount rates, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.10 percentage points over the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPI inflation exceeding 3.0% signals persistent inflationary pressures that prompt aggressive monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY inflation exceeds 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent month-over-month growth in consumer spending (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) exceeding 0.5% indicates robust aggregate demand, boosting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when both RSAFS and HOUST grow MoM by at least 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production (INDPRO) below 106.0 (0.3% MoM decline) signals supply constraints that pressure corporate margins, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO declines by more than 0.3% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained month-over-month increase in payroll employment (PAYEMS) exceeding 0.2% signals improving labor market conditions that support consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS grows MoM by at least 0.2%.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts (HOUST) exceeding 1700 thousand units signals strong residential construction activity and consumer confidence, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST exceeds 1700 thousand units.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent decline in federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) exceeding 0.10% MoM and unemployment rate above 5.5% signals stimulative policy for economic weakness, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines by more than 0.10% MoM and UNRATE exceeds 5.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeding 6.0% signals economic weakness that pressures corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 6.0%.
